ACTION 06 OF 32 · PHASE 02

Check Caribbean and regional alternatives

See how others solve the same customer problem with regional logistics, payments and customer behavior.

WHEN TO DO THISAfter understanding the best global patterns.ESTIMATED WORK TIME30–60 min
↗
Your one job

See how others solve the same customer problem with regional logistics, payments and customer behavior.

01

Do this now

  1. 01

    Identify operators in the Caribbean and nearby comparable markets.

  2. 02

    Compare island coverage, partnerships, contact channels, delivery constraints, online reputation and pricing where publicly available.

  3. 03

    Pay attention to regional problems: freight, staffing, payment acceptance, seasonality, cross-island travel and language.

  4. 04

    Record possible partner businesses as well as competitors.

02

Copy this into ChatGPT

Replace anything in [square brackets] with your real business details. The prompt is a shortcut, not a substitute for the steps above.

READY-TO-USE PROMPT
Using actual cited sources, map businesses in the Caribbean that solve [PROBLEM] for [CUSTOMER]. Compare country/island, channels, service model, published pricing (if visible), operating constraints, partnerships, customer objections and underserved opportunities. Include regional substitutes. Do not claim a company serves a country without evidence; label unverified coverage.
03

Finish with this

Regional market map: competitors, substitute solutions, logistical gaps and partner candidates.

Before moving on, check your work against the following:

  • Regional competitors and substitutes are listed
  • Island-level limits and dependencies are identified
  • Potential partners are separated from competitors
DON’T MAKE THIS MISTAKE

Assuming every Caribbean island has the same regulations, costs or customers.

READY TO MOVE ON?

At least three relevant alternatives are documented; there's a plausible customer gap and a way to test it.
